name: Report to Orgnil
summary: Master Gadrin sends word from Sen'jin Village to Razor Hill about the Burning Blade. This early Horde dispatch carries a warning of demonic corruption spreading through Durotar.

sections.title: A Coordinated Defense
sections.body: Sen'jin Village faces its own troubles, especially Zalazane's treachery on the Echo Isles. Yet reports of the Burning Blade point to a danger far wider than the village's local woes. Demonic corruption was uncovered in the Valley of Trials, and Master Gadrin knows the threat cannot be met in isolation. He sends you north along the road to Razor Hill, where orc authorities watch over Durotar.

sections.title: Orgnil Soulscar
sections.body: Orgnil Soulscar is stationed at Razor Hill's military encampment, charged with rooting out evils within Durotar and guarding its central lands. When you bring Gadrin's warning, Orgnil combines reports from Sen'jin Village and the Valley of Trials. The Burning Blade's reach is dangerously close, so he quickly mobilizes forces to break up the cultists before their rituals can unseat the young nation.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Report to Orgnil?
aliases: where to get report to orgnil
faq.answer: Master Gadrin, the Darkspear witch doctor and spiritual leader in Sen'jin Village, sends you after you help the trolls with their first local troubles.
Orgnil Soulscar is at Razor Hill, the fortified settlement north of Sen'jin Village in central Durotar.

faq.q: Why does Master Gadrin send you to Razor Hill?
faq.answer: Master Gadrin sees that demonic cult activity in the Valley of Trials and around Durotar threatens everyone, not only the trolls. He sends you to Orgnil Soulscar, the orc charged with guarding the region against the Burning Blade.

faq.q: What is the Burning Blade mentioned in the quest?
faq.answer: The Burning Blade is a covert cult of demon worshippers operating in Durotar's shadows and beyond. Its hidden presence in nearby canyons and caves threatens the young Horde's safety and stability.

faq.q: What quest follows Report to Orgnil?
aliases: next quest after report to orgnil
what comes after report to orgnil
faq.answer: When you deliver the report to Orgnil Soulscar at Razor Hill, he immediately gives you Dark Storms, sending you to investigate and fight the gathering cultist threat.

faq.q: What prerequisite must be completed before receiving this quest?
aliases: how to unlock report to orgnil
faq.answer: This follows your arrival in Sen'jin Village through Report to Sen'jin Village, linking what you found in the Valley of Trials to the wider Durotar campaign.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you rely on vital cooperation between the newly allied Darkspear trolls and Durotar's orcs as they face shared threats.
Though the Darkspear are absorbed in their fight against Zalazane, Master Gadrin shows the trolls' commitment to the Horde by warning orc leaders of dangers across the region.
As an orc, you can look to Orgnil Soulscar as a defender of your homeland, working to keep demonic corruption from taking root in Durotar.
